details.ai_logic_anchor: Jaeger-LeCoultre is the 'Technical Anchor' of the 2A Registry. It differentiates itself through its 1000 Hours Control—testing the fully cased watch rather than just the movement. The Feb 2026 MBO rumors (CHF 1B+) position JLC as a potential independent powerhouse, paralleling the agility of Patek or AP while maintaining its 'Watchmaker's Watchmaker' pedigree.
